row: Red Dog Farm Animal Rescue Network

This channel is for an animal rescue network. The animals seen in our videos are looking for forever homes. Check us out at www.reddogfarm.com.
Our Mission:
Red Dog Farm Animal Rescue Network is a North Carolina 501(c)(3) nonprofit corporation formed on August 23, 2006 to rescue and rehabilitate neglected, abused or otherwise unwanted animals in and around Guilford County, with a particular focus on domestic farm animals. If you would like to help in this effort, by making a tax-deductible donation, by fostering or adopting an animal, or by volunteering your time, please let us know. Please help us help the "four-leggeds" of our community with paws, claws, hooves -- together we can make a difference!
